name: Stags Leap District
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Warmth, steady breezes and volcanic soil give fruit with concentrated color and intense flavor.

blurb.text: A small Napa Valley AVA, only about one by three miles, noted for Cabernet Sauvignon. Soil sets it apart: loams from old Napa River sediment and volcanic soil eroded from the Vaca Mountains. A 1973 Cabernet Sauvignon from the district ranked first among the reds at the 1976 Judgment of Paris.
